notes: A dense tree ring with a single south corridor, inside it a garden and plaza clearing with an open shelter.

The corridor is the one gap in the ring, which is the kaya shape's distinguishing structure; the place records it so a ring that closes the corridor is refused as a walkability refusal rather than shipped.
